body: The hand axe with a seed sack are tied in one bundle. an acrid film marks the field side; torn warning tape marks the other.
title: Hand axe with a seed sack at on the cold night
gloss: A mixed bundle keeps field activity and emergency response equally plausible.
rival_reading: The bundle could belong to field workers caught in a response or responders crossing a work site; it preserves both readings.

title: Grass along the shoulder
body: The deer came from a pasture that had been sprayed yesterday. Its mouth was wet with a bitter smell; the driver said the creek near the rows smelled the same. We had just crossed the county line and had not heard any warning about the fields.
rival_reading: The containment response might explain a contaminated object or warning being displaced.
gloss: A witness records evidence of exposure near treated land.
